<onlyinclude>Most [[Mastery]]-rewarding items can be directly bought, built, or researched. However the following items had a limited distribution period or were removed from circulation entirely. Most of these items can be still be acquired, but may require waiting for specific events or trading with other players. 

<tabber>

|-|Nightwave =
'''Acquisition:''' [[Wolf Beacon]] and [[Nightwave/Offerings|Nightwave Offerings]]
<br>
{{Weapon|Wolf Sledge}} is only obtainable by killing the [[Wolf of Saturn Six]]. He spawned during the [[Nightwave/Series 1]] and can now only spawn with a [[Wolf Beacon]]. {{Weapon|Vitrica}} is only obtainable by killing [[Nihil]] after purchasing the Nihil's Oubliette decoration and the Enter Nihil's Oubliette Key.
